title: Admins may notice that Cloud PC service components aren't updating
impact: Admins may have noticed that Cloud PC service components weren't updating.

updates.content:
Title: Admins' Cloud PC components may not be updating

User impact: Admins' Cloud PC components may not be updating.

More info: Admins notice that their Cloud PC components may not be updating; however, there's no impact to general user connectivity to the Cloud PCs.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Windows 365 and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins may notice that Cloud PC service components aren't updating

User impact: Admins may notice that Cloud PC service components aren't updating.

More info: Admins may notice that their Cloud PC service components, including the remote desktop (RD) agent or side-by-side stack, aren't updating. There's no impact to general user connectivity to the Cloud PCs.

Current status: We've identified a recent service change that added new endpoint URLs that weren't publicly communicated, which prevented admins from adding them to their allow lists and is causing impact by blocking the requests to update Cloud PC service components. We're reversing the service change to revert back to our previous list of endpoint URLs and remediate the impact.

Scope of impact: Any admin expecting updates to their Cloud PC service components may be impacted.

Root cause: A recent service change added new endpoint URLs that weren't publicly communicated, which prevented admins from adding them to their allow lists and is causing impact by blocking the requests to update Cloud PC service components.

Next update by: Thursday, September 3, 2026, at 6:00 PM UTC

Title: Admins may notice that Cloud PC service components aren't updating

User impact: Admins may have noticed that Cloud PC service components weren't updating.

More info: Admins may have noticed that their Cloud PC service components, including the remote desktop (RD) agent or side-by-side stack, weren't updating. There was no impact to general user connectivity to the Cloud PCs.

Final status: We've reversed the service change to revert back to our previous list of endpoint URLs and confirmed through internal testing that the impact is remediated as a result for this action.

Scope of impact: Any admin that expected updates to their Cloud PC service components may have been impacted.

Start time: Monday, August 17, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC

End time: Thursday, September 3, 2026, at 5:25 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent service change added new endpoint URLs that weren't publicly communicated, which prevented admins from adding them to their allow lists and caused impact by blocking the requests to update Cloud PC service components.

Next steps: 
- We're reviewing our service change testing and validation procedures to identify and prevent similar issues with changing endpoint URLs before notifying admins moving forward.

This is the final update for the event.
